_comment: MultiForge modpack egg for Minecraft 26.1.x. Modpacks are never bundled.
name: MultiForge Modpack (26.1)
author: admin@nullsect0r.dev
description: MultiForge with a modpack's official server files on Minecraft 26.1.x and Java 25. Set an exact MultiForge version, the pack URL or an uploaded server.zip, and its SHA-256.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# MultiForge modpack installation script (Minecraft 26.1.x, Java 25).
#
# Server files: /mnt/server
#
# Modpacks are not redistributed. Set PACK_URL to the pack's official server
# files, or upload them as server.zip, and set PACK_SHA256.
set -euo pipefail

fail() { echo "ERROR: $*" >&2; exit 1; }

apt-get update -y
apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends curl ca-certificates coreutils unzip

mkdir -p /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server

JAVA_MAJOR=$(java -XshowSettings:properties -version 2>&1 | sed -n 's/^ *java\.specification\.version = //p' | head -n 1)
[ "${JAVA_MAJOR}" = "25" ] || fail "the install container runs Java ${JAVA_MAJOR:-unknown}; Minecraft 26.1 needs Java 25."

## An exact version only: "latest" is the 1.21.1 line and would break this server.
VERSION="${MULTIFORGE_VERSION#v}"
[[ "${VERSION}" =~ ^[2-9][0-9]*\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+(-[a-z]+\.[0-9]+)?$ ]] \
    || fail "MULTIFORGE_VERSION must be an exact 2.x release such as 2.0.0-alpha.1, not '${MULTIFORGE_VERSION}'."
[[ "${MC_VERSION:-}" =~ ^26\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$ ]] || fail "MC_VERSION must be a 26.x version such as 26.1.2."
PACK_SHA256=$(printf '%s' "${PACK_SHA256:-}" | tr 'A-F' 'a-f')
[[ "${PACK_SHA256}" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{64}$ ]] || fail "PACK_SHA256 must be the pack's 64-character SHA-256."

WORK=$(mktemp -d /tmp/mf-pack.XXXXXX)
trap 'rm -rf "${WORK}"' EXIT

## Check the release before changing anything on the server.
REPO="${MF_RELEASE_BASE:-https://github.com/0xnullsect0r/MultiForge/releases/download}"
BASE="${REPO}/v${VERSION}"
ASSET="multiforge-${VERSION}-installer.jar"
echo "-- Downloading MultiForge ${VERSION} --"
curl -fsSL -o "${WORK}/${ASSET}" "${BASE}/${ASSET}" || fail "could not download ${ASSET}."
curl -fsSL -o "${WORK}/SHA256SUMS" "${BASE}/SHA256SUMS" || fail "the release has no SHA256SUMS."
EXPECTED=$(awk -v f="${ASSET}" '{ n = $2; sub(/^\*/, "", n); if (n == f) print $1 }' "${WORK}/SHA256SUMS")
[ -n "${EXPECTED}" ] || fail "SHA256SUMS has no entry for ${ASSET}."
(cd "${WORK}" && echo "${EXPECTED}  ${ASSET}" | sha256sum -c -)

## Find and verify the pack.
PACK="${WORK}/pack.zip"
if [ -n "${PACK_URL:-}" ]; then
    echo "-- Downloading the modpack --"
    curl -fsSL --retry 3 -o "${PACK}" "${PACK_URL}" || fail "could not download PACK_URL."
elif [ -f server.zip ]; then
    cp server.zip "${PACK}"
else
    fail "set PACK_URL or upload the pack's server files as server.zip."
fi
echo "${PACK_SHA256}  ${PACK}" | sha256sum -c - || fail "the pack does not match PACK_SHA256."
unzip -Z1 "${PACK}" > "${WORK}/entries" || fail "the pack is not a valid zip."
if grep -qE '(^/|(^|/)\.\.(/|$))' "${WORK}/entries"; then fail "the pack contains unsafe paths."; fi
mkdir "${WORK}/pack"
unzip -q "${PACK}" -d "${WORK}/pack"

ROOT="${WORK}/pack"
if [ ! -d "${ROOT}/mods" ]; then
    mapfile -t TOP < <(find "${ROOT}" -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1)
    [ "${#TOP[@]}" -eq 1 ] && [ -d "${TOP[0]}/mods" ] || fail "the pack has no mods folder."
    ROOT="${TOP[0]}"
fi

## Refuse a pack made for another Minecraft version.
PACK_NEOFORGE=$(find "${ROOT}" -maxdepth 1 -name 'neoforge-*-installer.jar' -printf '%f\n' | sed -E 's/^neoforge-(.*)-installer\.jar$/\1/' | head -n 1)
if [ -z "${PACK_NEOFORGE}" ] && [ -f "${ROOT}/startserver.sh" ]; then
    PACK_NEOFORGE=$(sed -n 's/^NEOFORGE_VERSION=//p' "${ROOT}/startserver.sh" | tr -d '"\r' | head -n 1)
fi
[ -n "${PACK_NEOFORGE}" ] || fail "could not tell which NeoForge version the pack needs."
case "${PACK_NEOFORGE}" in
    "${MC_VERSION}".*) ;;
    *) fail "the pack needs NeoForge ${PACK_NEOFORGE}, which is not Minecraft ${MC_VERSION}." ;;
esac

## A world must not silently change modpack.
MARKER=.multiforge-pack
INSTALLED=$(cat "${MARKER}" 2>/dev/null || true)
LEVEL=$( { sed -n 's/^level-name=//p' server.properties 2>/dev/null || true; } | tr -d '\r' | head -n 1)
HAS_WORLD=0
[ -f "${LEVEL:-world}/level.dat" ] && HAS_WORLD=1
if [ "${INSTALLED}" != "${PACK_SHA256}" ] && { [ -n "${INSTALLED}" ] || [ "${HAS_WORLD}" = "1" ]; } && [ "${ALLOW_PACK_CHANGE:-0}" != "1" ]; then
    fail "this server already has a different pack or a world. Back it up, then set ALLOW_PACK_CHANGE to 1 to replace the pack."
fi

if [ "${INSTALLED}" = "${PACK_SHA256}" ]; then
    echo "-- Same pack as before: keeping mods and configs --"
else
    if [ -d mods ] && [ -n "$(ls -A mods 2>/dev/null)" ]; then
        BACKUP=".pack-backup-$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S)"
        echo "-- Keeping the previous mods and configs in ${BACKUP} --"
        mkdir "${BACKUP}"
        cp -a mods "${BACKUP}/"
        [ -d config ] && cp -a config "${BACKUP}/"
        rm -rf mods
    fi
    echo "-- Installing the modpack --"
    rm -f "${ROOT}"/neoforge-*-installer.jar "${ROOT}"/startserver.sh "${ROOT}"/startserver.bat
    mv "${ROOT}/user_jvm_args.txt" "${WORK}/pack_jvm_args.txt" 2>/dev/null || true
    ## Existing configs win: a changed pack must not overwrite an operator's settings.
    if [ -d config ] && [ -d "${ROOT}/config" ]; then
        cp -an "${ROOT}/config/." config/
        rm -rf "${ROOT}/config"
    fi
    cp -a "${ROOT}/." .
    rm -f server.zip
    if [ ! -f user_jvm_args.txt ] && [ -f "${WORK}/pack_jvm_args.txt" ]; then
        ## The panel's memory limit sets the heap, through MaxRAMPercentage in the startup command.
        grep -vE '^[[:space:]]*-(Xms|Xmx|XX:\+AlwaysPreTouch)' "${WORK}/pack_jvm_args.txt" > user_jvm_args.txt
    fi
fi

echo "-- Running the MultiForge installer --"
java -jar "${WORK}/${ASSET}" --installServer /mnt/server
rm -f ./*.log

ARGS_PATH=$( { sed -n 's|.*@\(libraries/net/neoforged/neoforge/[^/]*/unix_args\.txt\).*|\1|p' run.sh 2>/dev/null || true; } | head -n 1)
[ -n "${ARGS_PATH}" ] && [ -f "${ARGS_PATH}" ] || fail "the installer left no NeoForge launch arguments."
case "${ARGS_PATH}" in
    "libraries/net/neoforged/neoforge/${MC_VERSION}."*"-multiforge-${VERSION}/unix_args.txt") ;;
    *) fail "the installer produced ${ARGS_PATH}, not MultiForge ${VERSION} for Minecraft ${MC_VERSION}." ;;
esac
ln -sf "${ARGS_PATH}" unix_args.txt

if [ ! -f server.properties ]; then
    printf 'server-ip=0.0.0.0\n' > server.properties
fi
printf '%s\n' "${PACK_SHA256}" > "${MARKER}"

## The EULA is not accepted here: the panel's EULA feature asks the server owner.
echo "MultiForge modpack installation complete."

variables.name: MultiForge Version
variables.description: Exact MultiForge 2.x release, for example 2.0.0-alpha.1. 'latest' is refused because it is the 1.21.1 line.

variables.name: Minecraft Version
variables.description: The Minecraft version this server and pack must use.

variables.name: Pack URL
variables.description: URL of the pack's official server files. Leave empty to use an uploaded server.zip.

variables.name: Pack SHA-256
variables.description: SHA-256 of the pack's server files.

variables.name: Allow Pack Change
variables.description: Set to 1 to replace a different pack on a server that already has one or has a world. Back up first.
